title: Special Bulk Regulations
previewText: Where an easement volume is provided, the applicable bulk regulations of this Resolution shall be modified in accordance with the provisions of this Section. Where a clear path is provided, only the street wall provisions of Section 66-233 (Special street wall modifications) shall apply.
